question: does a per-centre lambda (hierarchically shrunk) beat the frozen HAM lambda off HAM?

evaluation_surface.primary: manifest_v4 split=reserved, BCN rows (79 under-40 escalating lesions), deployed V1 ensemble, read once
evaluation_surface.descriptive: reserved MSKCC rows (24 under-40 escalating lesions)
evaluation_surface.ham: HAM has no reserved rows; HAM tables are dev-only

arms.PC: pooled over centres per band (attribution reference)
arms.P2r: P2 with S58's router-predicted centre (router 'ham' -> HAM table)

primary_endpoint.quantity: BCN reserved under-40 escalation sensitivity (image-level), P2 - P0
primary_endpoint.interval: lesion-grouped (group_id) paired percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 42, resampling lesions within BCN under-40
primary_endpoint.p_value: two-sided bootstrap p; family = {P2 vs P0 on BCN}, a single member, no Holm
primary_endpoint.always_quoted_with: BCN under-40 referral P2 vs P0 and its paired delta

secondary_descriptive: P1 - P0, PC - P0, P2 - PC, P2r - P0 on BCN under-40 sensitivity
per centre x band: sensitivity, specificity, referral, NNB (pi 0.01/0.03/0.05)
Macro-F1 and balanced accuracy per centre
MSKCC: every quantity above, descriptive only (24 lesions)

gates.1_primary: delta >= 0.1 AND 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND p < 0.05; directional if delta >= 0.1 with CI including 0
gates.2_specificity: BCN reserved, per band: P2 specificity >= P0's - 0.02; the 0.85 floor is reported, not relaxed (P0 already misses it at 40-59 on reserved, S57a)
gates.3_noninferiority: BCN Macro-F1 and balanced accuracy: lower 95% bound of (P2 - P0) > -0.02; BCN 40-59 and 60+ P2 sensitivity >= P0's Clopper-Pearson lower bound
gates.4_referral: BLOWOUT if BCN under-40 referral P2 / P0 > 1.5
gates.5_router: BCN under-40 sensitivity P2r - P0: 95% CI lower bound > 0 (the gain survives routing)

verdict_logic: REJECT-cost: gate 1 passes and gate 4 BLOWOUT
PROMISING: gate 1 directional, gates 2, 3, 5 pass, no BLOWOUT (P0 stays deployed)
on_adopt: freeze tables into research/agerule/results_oof/lambda_by_centre.json and add frozen_params.load_lambda_by_centre() as the only loader (S65 may then take P2)
caveat_declared: a BCN gain compensates for V1's poor BCN transfer (Macro-F1 0.402); it does not fix ranking -- no lambda beats a centre's own ROC curve (S64)

stated_before_the_read.tau_star_is_inf: the tau grid is flat within 1 SE, so the declared rule takes full shrinkage: P2 = PC except where the per-centre floor repair lowers a band. The data do not support a per-centre deviation beyond what the floor forces.
stated_before_the_read.bcn_under40_is_floor_bound: BCN's local under-40 lambda (0.66) sits where the 0.85 specificity floor binds, not at the cost optimum; S14's 0.91 had no floor.
stated_before_the_read.p0_cheapest_by_breaking_the_floor: P0 has the lowest CV cost only because it is not floor-held: its cross-fitted BCN 40-59 specificity is ~0.75. Cost across arms with and without the floor is not like-for-like.
stated_before_the_read.gate4_expected_to_fire: cross-fitted BCN under-40 referral P0 ~0.062 vs P2 ~0.199 (ratio ~3.2). The 1.5x rule is S57b's, kept unchanged; P0's base referral is below BCN's under-40 prevalence (0.119), so the ratio is harsh here. Extra referrals per extra caught case is reported beside it, descriptive.
stated_before_the_read.p2_moves_ham_too: with tau* = inf HAM's under-40 lambda becomes the pooled 0.66 (frozen 0.26); cross-fitted HAM under-40 referral 0.076 -> 0.153. HAM has no reserved rows, so this is a dev-only finding S65 must weigh.

deviations.D1: tau by lesion-grouped 5-fold CV within centres (centre-equal-weighted held-out cost, 1-SE toward more shrinkage), not leave-one-centre-out: a held-out centre has no local estimate, so every tau collapses to PC there.
deviations.D2: HAM folds use S57a's nested panels (inner cross-fit calibration); BCN/MSKCC need none (HAM-fit map).
deviations.D3: alpha counts escalating images (S5/A7 unit); BCN has ~3.3 images per lesion; tau absorbs the scale.
deviations.D4: scc rows lack S13 V1 probabilities and are not fitting data; reserved includes S54's 146 top-ups.
deviations.D5: V4 val has zero under-40 escalating images: descriptive older-band check only.
deviations.D6: V1 ensemble probabilities only; S58's pooled head would need cross-fitted outputs (not built).
deviations.D7: dev ablation cross-fitted at tau*, which was chosen on the same folds (mildly optimistic for P2).
